headline: 10 injured, including principal of Dhaka Alia Madrasa, in Shibir-JCD clash
summary: Clashes erupted between Chhatra Dal and Shibir activists over the occupation of a dormitory hall, leading to injuries and reports of vandalism.
details: Clashes broke out between members of Chhatra Dal and Islami Chhatra Shibir on August 4 in front of the Government Madrasa-i-Alia in Bakshibazar, Dhaka.
The violence, which lasted throughout the day, left at least 10 people injured, including the principal of Dhaka Alia Madrasa.
The conflict reportedly centered around the occupation of a dormitory hall within the institution.
Reports indicate that the clashes involved multiple rounds of fighting, with allegations of vandalism and property damage inside the hall.
Following the confrontation, Shibir activists reportedly withdrew from the area, while Chhatra Dal members remained in the dormitory hall.
The incident has caused significant tension in the Bakshibazar area as student political wings continue to clash over campus control.
caption:
10 people injured, including a madrasa principal, after student political wings clash in Dhaka.

Clashes broke out between members of Chhatra Dal and Islami Chhatra Shibir on August 4 in front of the Government Madrasa-i-Alia in Bakshibazar, Dhaka.

The violence, which lasted throughout the day, left at least 10 people injured, including the principal of Dhaka Alia Madrasa.

The conflict reportedly centered around the occupation of a dormitory hall within the institution.

Reports indicate that the clashes involved multiple rounds of fighting, with allegations of vandalism and property damage inside the hall.

Following the confrontation, Shibir activists reportedly withdrew from the area, while Chhatra Dal members remained in the dormitory hall.

The incident has caused significant tension in the Bakshibazar area as student political wings continue to clash over campus control.

headline_marked: 5 arrested for [[forging seals of PM and ministers]] to influence jobs
headline: 5 arrested for forging seals of PM and ministers to influence jobs
summary: The DB police busted a forgery ring that used fake official seals, signatures, and letterheads to pressure officials for job reinstatements.
details: The Detective Branch (DB) of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police has arrested five members of a forgery ring, including the mastermind Faruk Hossain. The group allegedly forged the seals and signatures of the Prime Minister, various ministers, state ministers, MPs, and secretaries to influence government officials.

Faruk Hossain, a former electrical technician who was dismissed from a project under the Ministry of Labour and Employment in 2014, reportedly started the racket to get his job back. He created fake files using forged official letterheads and a counterfeit 'Priority' seal of the Prime Minister to expedite his requests.

During the operation, police seized 41 forged seals and signatures of high-ranking officials, four bundles of official letterhead pads of MPs and cabinet secretaries, eight mobile phones, two computers, and a laptop.

The investigation revealed that the gang also operated a fake WhatsApp account using the photo of the Prime Minister's protocol officer to pressure officials for job reinstatements. They also submitted a forged recommendation letter regarding manpower export to the relevant authorities.

The arrests were carried out in Madaripur's Kalkini and Kushtia. The information was shared by Additional Commissioner Md. Shafiqul Islam at a press conference held at the DMP Media Center on Minto Road.
